reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code, promo_type, start_date, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE start_date >= '2025-01-01' AND (discount_pct >= 30 OR promo_type = 'loyalty')
alternatives:
SELECT promo_code, promo_type, start_date, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE (discount_pct >= 30 OR promo_type = 'loyalty') AND start_date >= '2025-01-01'

SELECT promo_code, promo_type, start_date, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE (start_date >= '2025-01-01' AND discount_pct >= 30) OR (start_date >= '2025-01-01' AND promo_type = 'loyalty')

SELECT promo_code, promo_type, start_date, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE start_date >= '2025-01-01' AND NOT (discount_pct < 30 AND promo_type <> 'loyalty')
